correctness.rationale: SU(2) Clebsch–Gordan product chi_j chi_k=sum chi_{j+k-2h} gives the exact coefficient C_n; for n>=d the sum is r^n((n+1)S+T), with the only candidate negative k index at n=d-1,j=d,h=0 contributing coefficient zero, extending affine tail to n=d-1. Algebraic elimination yields the claimed r^(n-d+1)C_(d-1)+(n-d+1)r^n S identity. Peter–Weyl/Bochner central positivity makes individual C_n nonnegative necessary and sufficient, and asymptotic n forces S>=0. The square coordinate map has trivial kernel: all C_n=0 implies P_r q_b=0; P_r>0 everywhere, so b=0. An atomic measure with finitely many nonzero Peter–Weyl blocks must equal a smooth Haar-density Fourier polynomial yet is singular unless zero, so strictly positive tails imply strict finite-site PD; the converse finite rank fails on large finite subsets. All strictly positive coefficients are exactly uniform RKHS universality. Independently checked rational identities for radii 1/2,2/3,3/5 and d=1..6 through n=d+14 with exact fractions. Read source su2_poisson_checker.py, confirming its separate formulas and boundary tests. This is all degrees, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Finite positivity and universality tests for every character-polynomial degree replace infinitely many constraints with precisely d+1 independent facets, controlling strict/finite-rank/universal strata of a natural compact-group covariance kernel. This uniform all-degree structural result has clear use in harmonic-analysis kernel design; no broad theorem for other groups is claimed.

final_claim: For 0<r<1 and any degree d>=1, the central SU(2) Abel kernel P_r times arbitrary real mask sum_{j=0}^d b_j chi_j has positive type iff C_0..C_{d-1} and asymptotic slope S are nonnegative. Exact tail C_n = r^(n-d+1) C_(d-1)+(n-d+1)r^n S for all n>=d-1, and mask-to-constraints map is invertible, so the cone is simplicial with exactly d+1 facets/extreme rays. Within it strict finite-site PD iff C_(d-1)+S>0 and C-universality iff all low C_0..C_{d-1} are >0 (S may be 0).
